purpose: F-Droid is an installable catalogue of FOSS (Free and Open Source Software) applications for Android, allowing users to browse, install, and update apps from multiple repositories, including peer-to-peer nearby sharing without internet.
target_users: Android users who prefer free and open source software, privacy-conscious users, and developers distributing FOSS apps.

screens.name: Onboarding flows
screens.purpose: Show first-time guidance for main app areas, updates, filters, repositories, repo details, app issues, and anti-features
shows: Contextual tips or overlays for each onboarding topic

screens.name: Main app screen
screens.purpose: Entry point that initializes settings and notification managers, handles intents and permission requests; provides tabbed navigation to Discover, Search, My Apps, and Repositories
shows: Tab bar with Discover, Search, My Apps, Repositories

screens.name: App list screen
screens.purpose: Displays filterable, sortable list of apps from repositories with category, anti-feature, and repository filters; supports drag-and-drop reordering of items
shows: App list items with icons, names, summaries
Filter controls (categories, anti-features, repositories, incompatible toggle)
Draggable list items with visual feedback

screens.name: App details screen
screens.purpose: Show detailed information about an app including description, screenshots, versions, and install actions

screens.name: Add Repository Preview
screens.purpose: Shows a preview of a repository's apps and metadata before the user confirms adding it
shows: App list with names, package names, summaries, and icons

screens.name: Repositories list
screens.purpose: Manage configured repositories: enable/disable, reorder, add new, edit details
shows: List of repositories with name, address, enabled state

screens.name: Nearby swap start
screens.purpose: Let the user enable Bluetooth or Wi-Fi Direct, see nearby peers, and initiate an app swap session
shows: List of nearby peers with device names
actions: Select a peer to start swap

screens.name: Nearby app selection
screens.purpose: Let the user pick installed apps to share with a nearby device via the swap workflow
shows: List of installed apps with checkboxes

screens.name: Nearby Swap
screens.purpose: Guide the user through discovering nearby devices via Bluetooth and exchanging apps or repositories

screens.name: Swap Success
screens.purpose: Display apps received from a nearby swap and let the user install them
shows: List of received apps with install state

screens.name: Panic screen
screens.purpose: Provides an emergency exit or privacy feature that can be triggered to quickly hide the app or show a panic dialog

screens.name: Panic settings
screens.purpose: Configure panic mode behavior including hiding the app, exiting the app, and resetting repositories

features.name: Nearby Bluetooth app swap
features.description: Exchange apps and repositories with nearby devices over Bluetooth without internet

features.name: Crash reporting
features.description: Automatic crash collection and reporting via ACRA

features.name: Repository management
features.description: Configure and manage multiple app repositories with mirrors, certificates, and priorities

features.name: App installation management
features.description: Handle installation, update, and uninstallation of apps from repositories

features.name: Repository index parsing (v1 and v2)
features.description: Parse and serialize F-Droid repository index formats (v1 legacy and v2 current)

features.name: App metadata storage
features.description: Stores detailed app information including author, links, changelog, license, and localized text/assets

features.name: Local repo HTTPS certificate management
features.description: Generates and manages a keystore with self-signed certificates for serving a local F-Droid repo over HTTPS during nearby share

features.name: Panic mode configuration
features.description: Allows user to set actions triggered by panic gesture: hide app from launcher, exit app, wipe repo configuration

features.name: Drag and drop reordering
features.description: Enables reordering items in a Compose LazyList with animated drag preview and auto-scroll

features.name: App metadata model
features.description: Represents an app with package name, version codes, install status, and update availability

features.name: Repository database operations
features.description: CRUD and reordering for configured F-Droid repositories

features.name: App list UI state
features.description: Holds filtered/sorted app list, categories, anti-features, and filter badges for the main browse screen

features.name: Index v2 metadata serialization
features.description: Kotlin serialization for repository index v2 fields (name, summary, description, license, source, issue tracker, etc.)

features.name: Index v2 screenshot model
features.description: Stores screenshots for multiple device form factors (phone, 7-inch, 10-inch, wear, TV)

features.name: APK file sharing via ContentProvider
features.description: Exposes APK files via a ContentProvider so other apps can send/install APKs shared by F-Droid

features.name: Nearby app swap tracking
features.description: Models the result of a successful nearby app swap, including package details, version info, compatibility, and install state

features.name: Resumable file downloader
features.description: Downloads files (indexes, APKs) with support for resume, progress reporting, cancellation, and integrity verification

features.name: Package version serialization
features.description: Serializes/deserializes PackageVersionV2 objects for index v2 format, including metadata like anti-features, release channels, and signer info

features.name: App database
features.description: Room database storing app metadata, localized files, and full-text search index for apps across repositories

features.name: Full-text search
features.description: FTS entity for searching apps by name, summary, description, author, and package name

features.name: Repository preview before adding
features.description: Displays a list of apps from a repository with details so the user can decide whether to add it

features.name: Bluetooth HTTP-like request/response protocol
features.description: Implements GET and HEAD request handling over a Bluetooth connection for nearby app exchange

features.name: Repository manifest V2 serialization
features.description: Serializes and deserializes repository index manifests containing version info, permissions, features, and SDK requirements

features.name: Updatable app tracking
features.description: Tracks installed apps that have updates available, including version info, repo source, and vulnerability status

features.name: Onboarding state management
features.description: Persists onboarding visibility state per feature using SharedPreferences, with legacy migration

features.name: Repository configuration from swap intent
features.description: Parses incoming intents or URIs to extract repository details (host, credentials, fingerprint, Wi-Fi BSSID/SSID) for adding a repo received via nearby share

features.name: Notification channels and alerts
features.description: Creates dedicated notification channels and shows/cancels notifications for app installs, install success, repo updates, available app updates, and self-updates

features.name: Flexible download requests
features.description: Models download requests with support for multiple mirrors, proxy configuration, authentication, IPFS CIDs, and integrity verification (SHA256, size)

features.name: Type-safe navigation
features.description: Provides sealed navigation keys for Discover, Search, MyApps, Repos, AppList, and AppDetails destinations

network_calls.purpose: Fetch repository indexes and app metadata from configured repositories
network_calls.endpoint: Multiple repository URLs (e.g., https://f-droid.org, https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/repo, https://archive.newpipe.net/fdroid/repo, https://briarproject.org/fdroid/repo, https://guardianproject.info/fdroid/repo, IPFS gateways)

network_calls.purpose: Download APKs, index files, or other assets over HTTP/HTTPS with resume support
Exchange app metadata and APKs over Bluetooth using a custom HTTP-like protocol

permissions_justified.android.permission.CAMERA: Used by CaptureActivity for QR code scanning (e.g., scanning repository QR codes or app share codes)
permissions_justified.android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA: Required for reading/writing APK files and repository indexes to shared storage, and for USB OTG directory picking via OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE
permissions_justified.android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA: Allows installation of downloaded APKs from repositories, nearby shares, and local repo server
permissions_justified.android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: Needed to query installed apps for compatibility checking, swap operations, and displaying installed app list
permissions_justified.android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Reads APK files, repository indexes, and keystore from storage (legacy permission, still declared for compatibility)
permissions_justified.android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG: Writes downloaded APKs, indexes, and keystore to storage (legacy permission, still declared for compatibility)

platform_dependencies: Android Keystore / BouncyCastle provider for certificate generation
Camera (for QR code scanning via CaptureActivity)
PackageManager for installed app queries and component enabled state (panic hide/exit)
USB OTG support for external storage
Wi-Fi Direct / WifiManager for network peer discovery
